sample_unit: AI-generated responses (5 models x 3 scoliosis types)

links.outcome: Reading level (FKGL, FKRE) of AI-generated scoliosis patient education content
links.effect: DeepSeek-R1 lowest FKGL (6.2), highest FKRE (64.5); ChatGPT-o1 and ChatGPT-o3 mini-high scored above FKGL 12.0, requiring college-level reading skills.
links.quote: In contrast, ChatGPT-o1 and ChatGPT-o3 mini-high scored above FKGL 12.0, requiring college-level reading skills.

links.outcome: Presence of citations in AI-generated scoliosis responses
links.effect: All responses lacked citations, limiting reliability.
links.quote: However, all responses lacked citations, limiting reliability.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study evaluating readability and quality (DISCERN) of five LLMs generating patient education materials on scoliosis without evaluating a specific organizational deployment safeguard.
